title: The Athletic Launches ‘The Athletic LIVE,’ Its First YouTube Live Show

body_markdown:
“The Athletic LIVE,” a new interactive live show powered by The Athletic’s unparalleled sports newsroom, premieres Sept. 8.


The Athletic today announced the launch of “The Athletic LIVE,” a new interactive live show that brings together fans, journalists and creators for the savviest “group chat” in sports.


Premiering on Tuesday, Sept. 8, the show will kick off with three livestreams every week before ramping up to five weeknight shows in late October. Programming will shift between immersive watch-along, second-screen coverage on game days, as well as lively debates featuring The Athletic’s experts and other guests as they react to the day’s spiciest news during off nights.


The show will be co-hosted by a seasoned squad of experts, with leading N.F.L. analyst


**Charles McDonald** , football analyst and former college quarterback


**Max Browne** and The Athletic N.F.L. writer


**Daniel Popper** providing insight throughout the football season. The Athletic national N.B.A. writer


**Zach Harper** and independent sports content creator


**Kofie Yeboah** will bring their expertise to the show during the N.B.A. season. Independent sports journalist


**Joon Lee** will join the hosts as a weekly stats contributor. The show will continue to add more exciting talent to the lineup as coverage expands into additional sports.


The team will be joined by knowledgeable and entertaining voices across The Athletic universe, an array of guests … and fans themselves. As The Athletic’s first-ever livestreaming video show, “The Athletic LIVE” will feature interactive sports trivia, polls, live reactions to comments and more, giving fans the opportunity to make their voice heard and join the conversation about their favorite teams and leagues — right alongside our elite reporters and analysts.


“The Athletic LIVE” will be free to watch on YouTube, onsite and on The Athletic app. Fans can tune in every Sunday, Monday and Wednesday for watch-alongs and real-time debates, with more shows to be added as the season gets underway. The show will be broadcast live from our studio in Marina del Rey, Calif.


“With The Athletic LIVE, we’re creating a place for fans, journalists and other experts to come together in direct conversation,” said Jesse Burton, The Athletic’s head of Global Series & Specials. “I’m especially excited about the opportunity for fans to contribute to our live broadcasts and shape our coverage of the most important moments in sports.”


“The Athletic LIVE” is presented by Google Gemini.


“The Athletic LIVE” reflects The Athletic’s commitment to bringing fans closer to the stories and personalities shaping sports today. The show draws on the full strength of The Athletic’s award-winning global newsroom of more than 500 reporters and editors, whose journalism covers hundreds of professional and collegiate sports teams.


Charles McDonald is a football journalist and analyst from Charlotte. He has covered the N.F.L. for Yahoo Sports, the New York Daily News, and more.


Max Browne is the lead college football analyst for ESPN’s ACC Network Primetime Football. His broadcasting career includes roles with The CW, Pac-12 Network, Stadium and U.S.C. Browne is also an active football content creator with more than 300,000 followers across platforms and hosts the “Max Browne Show” on YouTube. Browne is a former quarterback and captain at both U.S.C. and Pitt.


Joon Lee is an independent sports journalist who founded Morning Announcements, the production company behind his YouTube channel on sports and culture. He’s written for ESPN, Bleacher Report, The New York Times and The Washington Post.


Daniel Popper is a national N.F.L. writer for The Athletic. He previously covered the Los Angeles Chargers and the Jacksonville Jaguars for The Athletic after following the New York Jets for the New York Daily News, where he spent three years writing, reporting and podcasting about local pro sports.


Zach Harper is a staff writer for The Athletic, covering the N.B.A. Zach joined The Athletic after covering the N.B.A. for ESPN.com, CBS Sports and FRS Sports since 2009. He also hosts radio for SiriusXM NBA and SiriusXM Mad Dog Sports Radio.


Kofie Yeboah is a Video Games and sports YouTuber originally from Raleigh, N.C. He’s a Pistons, Bengals, Mets and Carolina Hurricanes fan, and while his teams often let him down, that doesn’t stop him from having fun with sports content and analysis — “because at the end of the day,” he says, “it’s not serious.”


“The Athletic LIVE” joins The Athletic’s network of shows and series that brings listeners the latest news, in-depth analysis and insightful interviews across a wide range of fields, including “[Pablo Torre Finds Out](https://www.youtube.com/@PabloTorreFindsOut) ,” “[No Offseason](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/podcast/287-the-athletic-womens-basketball-show/) ,” “[The Athletic FC](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UC5lMsDXNh9jbafkCOnoGfZA) ,” “[The Tennis Podcast](https://www.youtube.com/@thetennispodcast) ” and more.
